verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents repeatable multi-step workflows rather than one-shot prompts. It offers a drag-and-drop visual builder with blocks and shareable templates, a code-first SDK for multi-step automations, and agents that can be scheduled and shared. Cached Playwright code makes repeat runs deterministic. However, none of the evidence mentions loop blocks, conditional branching, or workflow parameters/inputs, which are the specific composition features the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented loop constructs, conditional/branching logic, parameterized workflow inputs, independent hands-on corroboration of workflow composition.
